Subject: Nubex GCP private offer — draft terms and next steps

Hi Sara — great meeting earlier. Per our discussion, attached is a draft private-offer SOW and a preliminary P&L showing expected consumption patterns on GCP. Key asks from Nubex I captured are: 1) a 35% rev-share carve-out on usage for first 12 months, 2) a one-time onboarding credit of $60k, and 3) an early-termination right at 90 days with pro-rata refund.

We can list Redwood as the seller on the GCP private offer and set up a 60-day approval window for the marketplace listing. From our side, the main friction points are the 35% rev-share (higher than standard), the onboarding credit size, and the early-termination language.

Next steps I propose: Marissa (Deal Desk) to confirm feasible commercial adjustments, Naomi to validate the P&L impact, and me to coordinate with Legal for the termination language. If we need an executive signoff for any carveouts, please flag that early.

Attachments: Nubex_SOW_draft.pdf, deal_p&l_v2.xlsx

Thanks — Alex

Thanks Alex — confirming the asks from our side. A few clarifications:
- Rev-share: Nubex is requesting 35% of net revenue for the first 12 months, then reverting to 20% standard thereafter.
- Onboarding credit: $60k to cover model porting and initial LLM tuning work.
- Termination: 90-day early termination with pro-rata credit for unused committed minimums.

We understand these are outside standard marketplace templates but these are gating approvals for our CFO. Please provide a clear recommendation from Redwood on alternative structures (e.g., backloaded rev-share, capped onboarding credit, or milestone-based credits). We can loop finance once Redwood provides a counter.

Regards,
Procurement, Nubex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-01-09T11:36:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Nubex GCP private offer — draft terms and next steps

Vivek — forwarding the Nubex ask for executive approval guidance. Summary and recommendation below (please see attachments in the original thread):

Summary of request: 35% rev-share for 12 months, $60k onboarding credit, 90-day early-termination with pro-rata on committed minimums.

Impact: Naomi's P&L shows ~35% uplift to blended gross margin hit in year 1 if we accept the full ask; about $320k of total margin erosion across the first 12 months given their projected consumption (breakdown in deal_p&l_v2.xlsx).

Recommended approach (deal desk):
- Counter: 25% rev-share for first 9 months, then 20% thereafter.
- Onboarding credit: cap at $35k and tie to milestones (two migration checkpoints).
- Termination: 90-day right is OK if we require 60 days notice and a minimum 3-month committed consumption or pro-rata recovery for minimums; Legal to define specific carve language.

We need an executive exception to the rev-share floor (we typically don't go below 28% for first-year carveouts without VP approval). Given Nubex is a strategic vertical customer with multi-product upsell potential and a strong reference case, the revenue runway could justify the concession, but we need signoff.

Please reply with APPROVE / DENY / APPROVE WITH MODS and any quick comments. If APPROVE, cc Legal and Finance and I will implement terms in the private-offer listing.

—Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-09T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nubex GCP private offer — draft terms and next steps

Marissa / Alex — thanks for the concise write-up. I APPROVE WITH MODS. Conditions: 
1) Rev-share: Approve 25% for the first 9 months only (no longer than 9 months), then auto-revert to 20% with a clause to re-open on materially higher consumption.
2) Onboarding credit: Cap at $40k and paid against delivered milestones (migration complete, first 1M tokens consumed).
3) Termination: Accept 90-day right conditional on a 3-month minimum committed consumption and a pro-rata recoupment clause for any prepaid credits.
4) Legal must lock down termination language and confirm no indemnity expansion.
5) Finance to accept the revised P&L scenario; Naomi please confirm and update deal record.

Alex: you have authority to convey this counter to Nubex and finalize once Legal signs off. Marissa: please open a formal approval ticket in Deal Desk with these bullets and route to Legal & Finance.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
